title: Quenched Fluffy Ukrainian Ackee Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious post-workout Ukrainian dish featuring ackee, this pilaf is both umami and fluffy, making it a great ovo-vegetarian-friendly option.

ingredients.name: ackee
ingredients.notes: canned or fresh, drained and chopped

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and saute until translucent.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add cooked brown rice, chopped ackee, vegetable broth, smoked paprika, and beaten egg to the skillet.
Stir everything together, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Use a kitchen torch to flambe the top of the pilaf, if desired.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
